title: @dogtrax Such noise in the silence of the seas quiets the violence of verse as valid ballads burst into calm skies Our north star pointing a way to no
summary: @dogtrax Such noise in the silence of the seas quiets the violence of verse as valid ballads burst into calm skies Our north star pointing a way to nowhere for it is now that must be found #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@dogtrax Such noise
in the silence of
the seas
quiets the
violence
of verse
as valid
ballads burst
into calm skies

Our north star
pointing a way to
nowhere for it is now
that must be found
#smallpoems
